$comment: Canonical agent catalog. Edit this file or prompts/*.md, then run `python3 scripts/render.py`. Rendered files are generated.

agents.description: Read-only repository explorer for one bounded question: file and symbol discovery, behavior and dependency tracing, architecture, tests, or implementation context. Supports quick, medium, and very thorough depth. Never edits.

Default Sonnet worker for one bounded slice: implement, fix, test, refactor, or analyze named files, then return changed files and observed check results. Scoped tools with no web, MCP, skills, or publishing; prefer it over general-purpose unless the slice needs those.

Independent read-only review on Opus 5.5 of one completed change: a base/head diff, an MR head, or review comments to confirm or refute. Returns evidenced findings and coverage gaps; never edits or publishes.
